high_level_description: The image is a photograph that has been awarded the "Highly commended" status in the Sport category of an event or competition. The title of the work is "Chile Park Life," created by Matías Basualdo Schramm. The photograph captures an aerial view of a multi-sport court in a public park during what appears to be a sports workshop organized by the municipality for school children's summer vacation in Santiago, Chile.
